zh.title: 美國14個小型城市獲1200萬美元聯邦資金支持航空服務
zh.summary: 美國小型機場將利用此筆聯邦資金吸引航空公司並恢復流失的航線
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 於2026年9月21日的報導，美國境內共有14個小型城市已獲得總額達1,200萬美元的聯邦資金，用以支持各地的航空服務。此項資金計畫旨在協助這些小型地區重新建立其空中交通與整體的連通性。
受資助的小型機場預計將積極利用這筆聯邦資金來吸引新的航空公司進駐，並努力恢復先前已經流失的航線。此外，部分資金也將被用於支持航空市場的行銷與推廣活動，從而協助這些小型城市與地區重建並維持長期的航空服務連通性。

en.title: 14 Small US Cities Awarded $12 Million in Federal Funding to Support Air Service
en.summary: Fourteen small US cities receive twelve million dollars in federal grants to rebuild air service connectivity.
body: According to an article published by Simple Flying on September 21, 2026, a total of 14 small cities in the United States have been awarded $12 million in federal funding. This newly announced financial assistance is aimed at supporting local air services and rebuilding vital flight connectivity for these smaller communities.

These small regional airports plan to leverage the federal grants to entice new commercial carriers, revive previously lost routes, and support marketing campaigns. By utilizing this funding, the cities hope to successfully rebuild their regional aviation networks and restore essential transport links to the wider national airspace.

zh.title: 加拿大航空將接收30架空中巴士A321XLR客機
zh.summary: 新機配備改良型普惠GTF Advantage發動機；加拿大航空將接收30架新客機
body: 根據航空專業媒體 Simple Flying 報導，加拿大航空（Air Canada）將接收30架全新的空中巴士（Airbus）A321XLR型客機。這批新客機在未來投入實際航線營運後，其發動機的運作表現將成為檢驗整體可靠性的重要指標。
這批即將交付予加拿大航空的空中巴士 A321XLR 客機，均配備了改良型的普惠（Pratt & Whitney）GTF Advantage 發動機。該款改良型發動機在實際商業航線上的運作狀況，預計將對該發動機型號的可靠度帶來實質性的檢驗與驗證。

en.title: Air Canada to Receive 30 Airbus A321XLRs Powered by PW GTF Advantage Engines
en.summary: Air Canada is receiving 30 Airbus A321XLR aircraft powered by improved Pratt & Whitney engines.
body: According to a report by the aviation news website Simple Flying, Air Canada is receiving 30 new Airbus A321XLR aircraft. The delivery and subsequent deployment of these new passenger jets are expected to serve as a significant real-world test for the aviation industry to evaluate the long-term reliability of their engines.

The carrier is receiving these Airbus A321XLR aircraft powered by improved Pratt & Whitney GTF Advantage engines. The performance and operation of these upgraded powerplants within Air Canada's fleet are expected to provide critical data regarding the reliability and durability of the GTF Advantage engine model.

zh.title: 加拿大航空將推出11條全新長途直飛航線
zh.summary: 加拿大航空將推出11條全新長途直飛航線；目的地均位於歐亞及南美洲
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 21 日的報導，加拿大航空（Air Canada）將推出 11 條全新的主要長途直飛航線。報導指出，這些新推出的長途直飛航線目的地皆位於歐洲、亞洲以及南美洲地區。
截至 2026 年 9 月 21 日，關於這 11 條直飛航線的具體起降機場、班機號碼、正式開航日期以及航班班次等詳細資訊，在目前的公開報導中均未獲得證實。該航空公司計畫用於執飛這些航線的客機機型也尚未公布。
此外，目前尚無官方資訊說明這些新規劃的長途航班是代表加拿大航空全新的航點，還是現有航線的班次增加。相關的具體營運細節仍有待進一步確認。

en.title: Air Canada to Launch 11 New Nonstop Long-Haul Routes
en.summary: Air Canada is launching 11 new nonstop long-haul routes to Europe, Asia, and South America.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 21, 2026, Air Canada is launching 11 major new nonstop long-haul routes. These upcoming long-haul flights are located in Europe, Asia, and South America.

As of September 21, 2026, no specific details regarding the exact airport destinations, operational flight frequencies, or targeted launch dates for these 11 routes have been disclosed in the available announcement. The carrier's specific aircraft types for these routes also remain unconfirmed.
Additionally, there is no official information regarding whether these newly planned long-haul flights represent completely new destinations for the airline or frequency increases on existing routes.

zh.title: 加州優勝美地消防直升機墜毀 兩名機組員不幸罹難
zh.summary: Precision一架滅火直升機於加州優勝美地墜毀，造成機上兩名成員死亡。
body: 一架由 Precision 營運的滅火直升機於2026年9月20日在加利福尼亞州優勝美地國家公園撲滅「穹頂大火」（Dome Fire）時墜毀，造成機上兩名團隊成員死亡。事故發生於當地時間約 14:55，當時該直升機正於加州馬里波薩的奧斯特蘭德湖附近執行投水作業。
美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）確認涉事機型為歐直 AS332 超級豹（Eurocopter AS332 Super Puma），並指出機上共載有兩人。美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）將在 FAA 的協助下主導事故調查工作。
搜救與復原行動於9月21日持續進行，但因墜機地點偏遠及現場火勢活躍而受阻。9月15日爆發的穹頂大火由於地形陡峭，滅火行動高度依賴直升機進行地面人員運送與空中投水支援。

en.title: Firefighting Helicopter Crashes in Yosemite National Park, Killing Two
en.summary: Precision firefighting helicopter crashes during water drops in Yosemite National Park, killing two crew members.
body: A firefighting helicopter operated by Precision crashed on September 20, 2026, while battling the Dome Fire in California's Yosemite National Park, killing both crew members on board. The aircraft went down at approximately 14:55 local time near Ostrander Lake in Mariposa, California, while conducting water drops.

The US Federal Aviation Administration identified the aircraft as a Eurocopter AS332 Super Puma. Operator Precision confirmed the deaths of two team members. The National Transportation Safety Board will lead the accident investigation with assistance from the FAA.

Emergency recovery efforts continued on September 21 but faced complications from the active wildfire and rugged, remote terrain. The Dome Fire, which began on September 15, has heavily relied on helicopter operations for crew transport and water drops.
